purpose: Give readers one reading guide, one description of the current system, and one page for volatile state; correct the monitoring-host description and the fallback-aware watchdog status.
corrections: arena-server is the HP ProDesk; production monitoring runs there as the stream-v3-arena-monitor service, not as the k3s stream-v3-control workload.
The arena-server monitor can request guarded runtime restarts; documentation no longer describes those gates as migration-only surfaces.
The YouTube watchdog counts an established fallback-Pod connection as local delivery since 2026-10-20 14:16 JST; not yet observed during a real fallback.
Monitoring v4 relay observer and public projection run in production as read-only components.
CRA status is production-disabled rather than a deployment statement.
structure: docs/README.md is the only reading-order page; docs/00_INDEX.md is a described catalog grouped by topic.
Volatile items (recent changes, unobserved behavior, disabled features) live only in docs/current-status.md.
The scorecard detail table is split into current components and dated earlier evidence.
not_changed: dated case studies other than link and host-name corrections
